meta.usage: One manifest per scenario family instance M<density 1-4><interval N|W><demand C|F|H>. Copy this template, fill the <placeholders>, keep every field under 'preregistration' byte-identical -- those are frozen experiment-design decisions (spec D10; editing them after any experiment has run is a prereg violation).
meta.completeness_rule: The coarse/fine band values live ONLY in platform_kim2021.json (resolution.rho_req_bands). This template binds them by reference. If platform_kim2021.json still has status 'pending_D2_mapping_ticket', scenario generation must fail loud and generate nothing.

scenario.degenerate_anchor: <true only for M?NC: both margin pads = 0 (spec D4), fixed-duration regression anchor>

tiers.C: every target draws its resolution requirement from the COARSE band
tiers.F: every target draws its resolution requirement from the FINE band
tiers.H: fine:coarse = 1:1 uniform mix (per-target Bernoulli with p=0.5, drawn under the scenario seed)

band_values.note: Bound by reference only (spec D3 unique-source rule). A target whose requirement falls inside the two-band boundary zone belongs to NEITHER tier by default -- the boundary zone is only exercised by the cheap ablation below.

seed_convention.replication_structure: 5 variants x 10 seeds, same as Paper 1 (spec D10)
seed_convention.storage: scenario JSON/PKL carries integer field 'seed'; all stochastic stages (generation, solver init, repair, tie-breaks) consume this one seed
seed_convention.reproducibility_requirement: same seed rerun must reproduce results bit-identically (spec Testing Decisions: 确定性)

cheap_ablation_reserved.design: Tasks whose requirement falls inside the two-band boundary zone are allowed to be served by EITHER band (dual-mode eligibility at mapping time); comparison against the base mapping isolates the boundary-assignment effect.
cheap_ablation_reserved.status: REGISTERED ONLY -- NOT IMPLEMENTED. Enabled only if reviewers request it; any implementation ticket must reference this registration ID, never re-design in place.

run_artifacts.results_dir: <filled per run; must be inside the paper domain, gitignored if large>
run_artifacts.verify_gate: Paper-2 verify chain (spec D11) -- to be wired by its own ticket; zero-feasible / zero-output batches must exit with a distinguishing code, never fake success.
